impact.text: any dynamically calculated fee above 10% gets rejected

precondition_sources.text: A dynamically calculated fee is above 10% (100,000).

intent_sources.text: A dynamically calculated fee within DynamicSwapFeeModule's MAX_FEE_CAP (500,000) should be accepted by CLFactory.getSwapFee() rather than rejected.
CLFactory.getSwapFee() threshold should be aligned with DynamicSwapFeeModule.MAX_FEE_CAP (500,000) so full dynamic fees are allowed.
